candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get fever. For two days now e dey run temperature, the temperature na 38.0°C. E no dey get cough or dey breathe hard. Dem no see diarrhea for am. E no get any ear wahala. E never convulse before and e no dey convulse now. E dey active, e no dey weak or dey like person wey no sabi wetin dey happen. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. Dem check, dem no see any obvious cause for the fever. E never get measles for the last three months. E no get cough wey dey follow measles. Dem see say e get rash all over body. E no get mouth ulcer. Eye red and pus dey comot from the eye. Dem check, dem no see say the black part of the eye dey cloud. Dem check neck, e no stiff. E no get catarrh. Dem do malaria test, the test show negative. Dem fit do malaria test for here. This area na high malaria risk. Dem no identify bacterial cause for this assessment.
